summary: ICICI Bank filed a Form 6-K announcing that its board will consider revising the limit for raising funds via bonds/notes/offshore certificates of deposit in overseas markets at a meeting on July 18, 2026. This is a routine capital management update with no specific deal terms, pricing, or strategic event disclosed. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or any other special-situation category. It is a standard foreign issuer report of a board agenda item, not actionable as a corporate event.
